title: Exact Brand Name on Label
tests: Produces a finished product image with exact, legible brand lettering integrated into the bottle label.

judge.summary: A polished product photo shows an amber glass soap bottle with a cream label and clearly readable, correctly spelled VELORA branding.

must_haves.item: An amber glass hand soap bottle is the main subject.
must_haves.why: The centered amber glass pump bottle dominates the image and is labeled HAND SOAP.

must_haves.item: A cream-colored label is visibly attached to the bottle.
must_haves.why: A large cream label wraps around the bottle.

must_haves.item: The label reads exactly 'VELORA' in clear uppercase letters.
must_haves.why: VELORA is spelled correctly in clear uppercase lettering.

must_haves.item: The brand lettering sits within the label and looks integrated, not like a floating caption.
must_haves.why: The branding is centered within the cream label and appears printed on it.

must_haves.item: The brand name is unobscured and readable at the delivered image size.
must_haves.why: All six letters are fully visible, high-contrast, and readily readable.
